completion_bindings.admission: User authorized one bounded local 32-case pass; main executes only after exact source, reviews and freeze completion.

input_budget.policy: 256MiB counts actual provided-file bytes, not logical payload alone; every declared locator counts including identical train/restore copies. Runtime files are separate.
input_budget.reread_accounting: Before/after verification and parser/extraction rereads are real I/O. Execution records actual read operations/bytes and decompressed-member reads. Two full passes is an accounting estimate, not measured cost or a bound on all reads. Repeats do not create cases or evade input policy.

policies.authority_corruption: Fail before native evaluation; identity corruption never takes numerical fallback.
policies.both_zero_residual: Source-mapped native input residual, base and RHS identity plus cached prediction equal to base must be independently qualified before execution.
policies.candidate: Fixed GroupNorm final200 cached physical full pressure; no replay, training or selection.
policies.failure: Durable failed case and fail-stop; no advancing, cropping or retry.
policies.learned: Eligible proposal: at most 32 warm iterations then at most one fresh original p_base reset with at most 3000 iterations.
policies.primary_temporal: One fresh original p_base solve with at most 3000 iterations and no preliminary 32-iteration penalty.
policies.temporal_bounded: Diagnostic: at most 32 warm iterations plus one p_base reset with at most 3000 iterations; this is not the primary comparator.
policies.timing: Earlier restore inference remains historical. The enclosing native wall time over all methods is not candidate-only wall time. Missing timers remain unavailable.
policies.zero: One fresh zero solve with at most 3000 iterations.

portability: Portable logical paths accompany observed locators. Moving inputs requires exact bytes, modes, lineage and supported native/runtime qualification. Missing files stop admission; no regeneration, download or credential renewal.

runtime.dynamic_library_scope: readelf reports libgcc_s.so.1/libc.so.6/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2; conventional platform file bytes are bound, actual process mappings are not observed. Final source/runtime qualification binds effective launch/env.
runtime.historical_runtime_readcost_scope: Retained capturedCPU admission is historical evidence. Current audit reads manifest plus minimal local interpreter/NumPy/library closure, without runtime initialization.
